# StackPulse AI
> Autonomous Zero-Cost Developer Stack & Free-Tier Intelligence

StackPulse AI is an automated developer infrastructure & SaaS free-tier intelligence hub at https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/.

## Digital Products & Blueprints
- [2026 Zero-Cost Cloud & AI Stack Blueprint + Automation Prompt Pack ($19)](https://hotspot41.gumroad.com/l/ryqznu): Complete verified free-tier matrix across 28 developer & AI tools, live market signals, and ready-to-use synthesis prompts.
- [Free 2026 Developer Free-Tier Cheat Sheet & TCO Calculator (Free ($0))](https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/products/free-tier-cheatsheet.md): Zero-cost quick-start reference sheet with direct verified free-tier routes and 10k-visitor TCO cost breakdown.
- [Autonomous GitHub Actions & Make.com AI Agent Blueprint Pack ($19)](https://hotspot41.gumroad.com/l/ryqznu): Step-by-step blueprints to connect GitHub Actions, RSS feeds, and Make.com social auto-distribution at $0 overhead.
- [StackPulse AI — Weekly Featured Tool & Newsletter Sponsor Slot ($49)](https://hotspot41.gumroad.com/l/lcpwob): Pin your DevTool, SaaS, or AI product across our homepage directory header, RSS feed, and automated developer digest.

## All Verified $0 Tools
- **GitHub Actions** (Automation & Workflows, 9.9/10): Free tier: Unlimited minutes on public repos; 2,000 mins/mo on private repos | Paid: $0.008/min beyond private free quota | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/github-actions.html
- **Cloudflare Pages & Workers** (Cloud Hosting & Edge, 9.8/10): Free tier: Unlimited sites & bandwidth, 500 builds/mo, 100k Worker requests/day | Paid: $5/mo Workers Paid | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/cloudflare-pages.html
- **Google Gemini API (AI Studio)** (AI & LLM APIs, 9.6/10): Free tier: Free tier via Google AI Studio (RPM/RPD limits, no credit card required to start) | Paid: $0.10-$0.30 / 1M input tokens (Flash tier) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/google-gemini-api.html
- **Lemon Squeezy** (Payments & MoR, 9.6/10): Free tier: $0/month fixed cost; 5% + $0.50 only when a sale happens | Paid: Transaction-only pricing (no monthly subscription) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/lemon-squeezy.html
- **PostHog** (Email, Growth & Analytics, 9.6/10): Free tier: 1M analytics events/mo + 5,000 session recordings + 1M feature flag requests free | Paid: Pay-as-you-go beyond 1M events/month | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/posthog-analytics.html
- **Supabase** (Serverless Databases, 9.5/10): Free tier: 2 active free projects, 500MB database, 50,000 monthly active users, 5GB egress | Paid: $25/mo Pro plan | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/supabase.html
- **Polar.sh** (Payments & MoR, 9.5/10): Free tier: $0/month fixed cost; 4% + $0.40 only when a sale happens | Paid: Transaction-only pricing (no monthly fee) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/polar-sh.html
- **Cursor AI Editor** (AI Coding & Agent IDEs, 9.5/10): Free tier: Free Hobby tier with limited Agent completions & Tab suggestions | Paid: $20/mo Pro plan | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/cursor-ai.html
- **Turso (libSQL)** (Serverless Databases, 9.4/10): Free tier: Up to 500 databases, 9 GB total storage, 1B row reads/mo | Paid: $29/mo Scaler plan | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/turso-sqlite.html
- **Stripe Payment Links** (Payments & MoR, 9.4/10): Free tier: $0/month fixed fee; pay only per successful transaction | Paid: 2.9% + $0.30 per card charge (US) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/stripe-checkout.html
- **n8n Workflow Automation** (Automation & Workflows, 9.4/10): Free tier: 100% free self-hosted Community Edition; 14-day cloud trial | Paid: €20/mo Starter Cloud (or $0 self-hosted) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/n8n-cloud.html
- **Resend** (Email, Growth & Analytics, 9.4/10): Free tier: 3,000 emails/month free (100 emails/day, 1 custom domain) | Paid: $20/mo Pro plan (50,000 emails) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/resend-email.html
- **Groq Cloud API** (AI & LLM APIs, 9.3/10): Free tier: Free developer tier with daily token/request caps across Llama & Mixtral models | Paid: $0.05-$0.59 / 1M tokens pay-as-you-go | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/groq-cloud.html
- **Windsurf (Codeium)** (AI Coding & Agent IDEs, 9.3/10): Free tier: Free forever tier with unlimited basic autocomplete + free prompt credits | Paid: $15/mo Pro plan | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/windsurf-ide.html
- **Neon Serverless Postgres** (Serverless Databases, 9.2/10): Free tier: 0.5 GB storage, 100 CU-hours/month compute, 10 branches per project | Paid: $19/mo Launch plan | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/neon-postgres.html
- **Make (Integromat)** (Automation & Workflows, 9.2/10): Free tier: 1,000 operations/month free forever, 2 active scenarios | Paid: $9/mo Core plan (10,000 ops) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/make-automation.html
- **Buttondown** (Email, Growth & Analytics, 9.2/10): Free tier: Free up to 100 subscribers with web archive and RSS support | Paid: $9/mo Basic plan (up to 1,000 subscribers) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/buttondown-email.html
- **OpenRouter** (AI & LLM APIs, 9.1/10): Free tier: Multiple `:free` model endpoints (rate-limited RPM/RPD, $0 required) | Paid: Pay-per-token pass-through pricing | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/openrouter.html
- **Railway** (Cloud Hosting & Edge, 9.1/10): Free tier: Free Trial credit ($5) + $1-$5/mo Hobby usage tier with scale-to-zero | Paid: $5/mo Hobby plan (includes $5 usage credit) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/railway-cloud.html
- **Gumroad** (Payments & MoR, 9.1/10): Free tier: $0/month fixed cost; flat 10% fee on direct sales | Paid: Pay-as-you-earn fee only | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/gumroad.html
- **Activepieces** (Automation & Workflows, 9.1/10): Free tier: 1,000 free tasks/mo on Cloud + unlimited self-hosted MIT Community Edition | Paid: $5-$10/mo Cloud (or $0 self-hosted) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/activepieces.html
- **Plausible / Umami Analytics** (Email, Growth & Analytics, 9.1/10): Free tier: Umami Cloud free (100k events/mo) or $0 self-hosted Plausible CE / Umami | Paid: $9/mo Plausible Starter (or $0 self-hosted) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/plausible-ce.html
- **Cloudflare D1** (Serverless Databases, 9.0/10): Free tier: 5 GB storage, 5M rows read/day, 100k rows written/day | Paid: $5/mo Workers Paid base plan | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/cloudflare-d1.html
- **GitHub Copilot Free** (AI Coding & Agent IDEs, 9.0/10): Free tier: 2,000 code completions + 50 chat/agent requests per month free | Paid: $10/mo Pro plan (free for verified students/maintainers) | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/github-copilot.html
- **Vercel** (Cloud Hosting & Edge, 8.9/10): Free tier: Hobby plan: 100 GB bandwidth/mo, non-commercial personal projects | Paid: $20/seat/mo Pro plan | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/vercel.html
- **Replit** (AI Coding & Agent IDEs, 8.9/10): Free tier: Free Starter tier with public workspaces and limited AI trial checkpoints | Paid: $20-$25/mo Core plan | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/replit-agent.html
- **Render** (Cloud Hosting & Edge, 8.8/10): Free tier: 100 GB bandwidth for static sites; 750 free web service hours (spins down idle) | Paid: $7/mo Starter web service | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/render.html
- **Hugging Face Inference** (AI & LLM APIs, 8.7/10): Free tier: Free rate-limited serverless inference + free CPU Spaces | Paid: $9/mo PRO plan for higher credits | Link: https://gamehotspot62.github.io/zero-cost-income-engine/go/huggingface-inference.html
